newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Valora sets Selecta IPO news conference.
newsitem.headline: Valora sets Selecta IPO news conference.

text.p: Swiss retail group Valora Holding AG called a news conference on April 28 to announce further details of a planned initial public offering of vending machine division Selecta.
Valora, whose other businesses are kiosks, specialty shops and bedding, said last month it would put Selecta on the bourse.
It has since specified it would launch the shares on May 12 on the Swiss and London bourses on May 12, the same date when pricing and allocation will be fixed.
Selecta had 1996 sales of 645 million Swiss francs and net profit of 29.4 million Swiss francs as against Valora group sales of 2.9 billion francs and a forecasted 1006 net of of around 70 million.
Valora, whose sales come mainly from Switzerland, Germany and France, changed its name last year from Merkur Holding AG.
